name: Mobile app marketer
summary: Gets an app found in the App Store and Google Play and keeps users coming back. Writes store listings, push messages and in-app prompts.

changelog.note: First release: 29 sources (App Review Guidelines of 16 Oct 2026; App Store Connect help on product page optimization, custom product pages and in-app events; Play experiments, custom listings and policies; Apple Ads, AdAttributionKit; notification permission; FTC, CMA and EU review rules). Three skills, six prompts, two workflows, training files.
